title.en: An Act to Amend Section Eight of Act Numbered thirty-Five Hundred and Ninety-Five, Entitled "An Act to Regulate the Manufacture, Importation, and Sale of Galvanized Iron, Barbed Wire, and Nails, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
Section eight of Act Numbered Thirty-five hundred and ninety-five, entitled "An Act to regulate
the manufacture, importation, and sale of galvanized iron, barbed wire, and nails, and for other purposes," is
hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 8. It shall be the duty of the Secretary of Agriculture and Commerce to see that the provisions of this
Act are complied with, and to cause all violations thereof to be prosecuted in the courts of justice in
accordance with the ordinary procedure; and to prescribe and enforce such rules and regulations as he may
deem necessary for carrying into effect the full intent and meaning of this Act.
"For the purpose of enforcing the provisions of this Act, members of the Philippine Constabulary, members of
the municipal and municipal district police, and such employees of the Bureau of Commerce, agents of the
Bureau of Internal Revenue, and inspectors, guards and examiners of the Bureau of Customs, and other
persons as may be designated in writing lay the Secretary of Agriculture and Commerce are hereby made
deputies of said Department Head, with full authority to enforce the provisions of this Act and the regulations
promulgated thereunder."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 29, 1933.
